title: The Penny Loses $86 Million A Year
hook: America's smallest coin creates a surprisingly large annual loss.
closing: Coin policy matters because tiny losses multiply across billions of pieces.
question: Would you miss the penny?

segments.say: The penny program loses 86 million dollars yearly. Keeping the coin has a real taxpayer cost.
The penny has remained in production for 232 years. Longevity helps explain why change is politically difficult.
One nickel costs 13.78 cents to produce. The penny is not the only money-losing coin.
